description: A language for websites: pages, look, logic and 3D in one .kaury file, compiled to fast server-rendered HTML. Built so that AI assistants write it right the first time.
rules: Read docs/kaury-ai.md first: it is the whole language in one file, written for AI assistants.
A block is a line followed by lines indented by exactly 2 spaces. Options are separated by commas. Text is between double quotes.
After writing a .kaury file, run `kaury check --json`, fix every problem it lists (each has its line and a fix), then run `kaury build`.
In the site block, `fonts "Text font", "Title font"`: the font of the text comes first, then the font of the titles.
A value that changes on screen is a `state`; a `let` made from a state follows it by itself.
Use the ready-made blocks for usual sections: Hero, Features, Steps, Stats, Table, Chart, Pricing, Testimonials, Faq, Contact, Footer.
Do not use Kaury for an application with accounts and a database, for payments, or for one widget inside an existing site.
